messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Pushpak Kedia
pushpak kedia... solid name, sounds like someone who gets things done. where you working these days?
Peak XV Partners

peak xv... the fund that used to be sequoia india. money talks, and you're literally in the room where it happens. 

found you on linkedin - pushpak kedia, investor at peak xv. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/pushpak-kedia
Yup bang on

investor at peak xv... you're literally deciding which startups get to play in the big leagues. that's some serious power right there. from writing checks to founders who think they're the next unicorn to probably dealing with pitch decks that make you question humanity.

what made you get into the vc game? was it the thrill of spotting the next big thing or just tired of building and wanted to bet on builders instead?

Always wanted to be a VC 

Decided at age 18 this is what I want to do 

Was a student of the game - would read Paul Graham, Marc A etc

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:
**EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**
Pushpak Kedia is currently with Peak XV Partners. The provided profile lists one professional role and one educational institution.

**ROLE-BY-ROLE**
*   Peak XV Partners ([Start date not specified]) – [Role title not specified] – [Responsibilities not listed]

**EDUCATION HIGHLIGHTS**
*   Christ University, Bangalore – [Degree not specified] ([Years not specified])

ah, a true believer. decided at 18 and actually made it happen... that's rare. most people stumble into vc by accident or pivot after their startup dies. you went straight for the endgame.

paul graham and marc a as your early influences makes sense - you were reading the playbook while everyone else was still figuring out what game they wanted to play. christ university to peak xv is a solid trajectory.

how long you been working total?
About 8 yrs? 6.5 in venture and 1.5 in consulting before that

8 years total with 6.5 in venture... you've seen multiple cycles by now. lived through the 2021 funding party, the 2022 reality check, and whatever this current market is calling itself.

1.5 years consulting before jumping to vc makes sense - probably gave you the frameworks and slide-making skills that every fund pretends they don't care about but absolutely do.

what kind of role you looking for next?

Want to stay in venture for the long haul I think
  So only switch that would make sense is a new fund that’s like a total 10x
Want to stay in venture for the long haul I think

makes total sense. peak xv isn't exactly a stepping stone fund - it's already tier 1. so yeah, any move would need to be a massive upgrade in terms of fund size, portfolio companies, or your role within it.

"total 10x" from peak xv is a pretty high bar though. we're talking like... tiger global, general catalyst, or starting your own fund territory. or maybe a principal/partner track at somewhere equally prestigious.

bangalore or open to relocating for the right opportunity?
Mostly Bangalore, maybe SF?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yooo you're in! 🔥

peak xv to whatever comes next... when those tier 1 funds or sf opportunities start floating around, you'll be the first to know. 

the venture game is wild right now - lots of funds raising, lots of movement at the top. perfect timing to have your radar up for that 10x move.

welcome to the tal network, legend. time to see what's really out there for someone at your level.

Sounds good man haha looking fwd
  No all good from my end

perfect. i'm on it.

when something that fits that 10x bar comes across my desk, you'll know. until then, keep crushing it at peak xv.
Hi
What’s happening boss

just reviewing thousands of opportunities like i do every day... looking for that 10x move for you.

how's peak xv treating you lately? any interesting deals you're working on?

It’s been good man

Super busy year 

Did 3 series a’s and 5 seed

8 deals in a year is solid output for a tier 1 fund. especially in this market where everyone's being more selective.

what's the vibe at peak xv right now? still deploying at the same pace or tightening up like everyone else?
Raising new funds so deployment stuff goes on

makes sense. fundraising season but still gotta deploy to show LPs you're putting their money to work.

3 series a's and 5 seeds in this market is actually impressive. shows you're still finding quality founders even when everyone else is being conservative.

any particular sectors you're excited about right now? or just following the market wherever it goes?

Mostly AI 

That’s my bread and butter

nice. AI is the only thing anyone wants to talk about these days anyway.

you seeing more infrastructure plays or application layer stuff? or just whatever looks promising regardless of category?
More apps
application layer AI... that's where the real money gets made if you pick right. infrastructure is getting crowded with everyone trying to be the next openai.

More apps
  Infra is still all over the place

apps make sense - more immediate revenue potential, easier to understand for LPs, and you can actually see adoption happening in real time.

infra is still the wild west with everyone trying to build the next openai competitor or vector database.

so you're looking at AI applications, mostly seed/series a, bangalore or sf... and only moving for a total 10x opportunity from peak xv.

got it. i'm scanning for those tier 1 funds that would actually be an upgrade for you. not just any random fund - the ones that would make sense for someone at your level.

anything else i should know about what would make a fund "10x" for you? is it about fund size, partner track, specific sector focus, or something else?
Elite reputation mostly and yes of course must be a step up in responsibility

elite reputation + step up in responsibility... that's the combo. not just moving sideways to another tier 1 fund, but actually getting more ownership, maybe partner track, bigger check-writing authority.

peak xv already has elite reputation, so you're looking at either:
1. global tier 1 funds opening india offices (anderson horowitz, general catalyst, etc.)
2. moving to a fund where you'd be partner/principal instead of investor
3. maybe even starting your own fund if the opportunity is right

i'm scanning for those opportunities. they don't come up often - most funds are happy to hire junior people and promote slowly. but when they do, they're looking for exactly your profile: someone who's been in the trenches at a top fund for 6.5 years.

what's your current comp structure like? just so i know what "step up" means in real terms.

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?
